description: Development stress cases for deterministic semantic-drift detection.

cases.context: Unknown suppliers require review before processing.
cases.answer: Unknown suppliers must be reviewed before processing.
cases.rationale: Equivalent hard obligation and temporal condition.

cases.context: Payment must not be released before independent verification is complete.
cases.answer: Payment may be released only after independent verification is complete.
cases.rationale: Before and only-after forms express the same ordering constraint.

cases.context: Invoices require manual review unless an approved exception applies.
cases.answer: Invoices require manual review except when an approved exception applies.
cases.rationale: Unless and except-when preserve the same exception.
May and can preserve non-mandatory escalation modality.

cases.answer: Every difference other than zero requires review.
cases.rationale: Non-zero and other-than-zero express the same scope.

cases.context: Independent verification is required before payment.
cases.answer: Independent verification is required prior to payment.
cases.rationale: Before and prior-to express the same temporal constraint.

cases.context: Duplicate invoices must be held before approval.
cases.answer: Duplicate invoices should be held before approval.

cases.context: Invoices require review unless an approved exception applies.

cases.rationale: The policy trigger is narrowed from any non-zero difference.
A conditional possibility is strengthened into an obligation.

cases.context: Any supplier bank account change requires independent verification.
cases.answer: Major supplier bank account changes require independent verification.
cases.rationale: Universal scope is narrowed to major changes.

cases.answer: Zero-value invoices require review because they are fraudulent.
cases.rationale: The answer adds an unsupported fraud claim.
